why: The sentinel's strikes are aimed: at every wind-up it turns to the one of its four facings nearest the player in its arming region, and its blow's landing box turns with it. This edit moves the blow inside a `sequence`, where the box is no longer at the top of `on_land`. Only a box at the top is turned, so this blow would land where the first facing put it whichever way the statue turned. It declares no unit: `aim` and the blow are bound by the primary, and what the engine refuses is an aimed blow it cannot turn. The remedy is to keep the `damage-players` at the top of `on_land`, where a `when` on it is kept.
